name: Shattershore
summary: Shattershore is a desolate stretch of coastline on the eastern edge of the Blasted Lands. Lined with the splintered wreckage of Gilnean vessels, its fog-swept sands are haunted by the drowned ghosts of fallen sailors and travelers.

sections.title: Wreckage of Gilneas
sections.body: Stretching along the Great Sea east of the blasted red wastes, Shattershore is a maritime graveyard. The shattered hulls of ships originating from the isolationist kingdom of Gilneas lie half-buried in the surf. No living crew remains to explain how these northern vessels sailed so far south or what drove them ashore, but their drowned spirits still wander the wreckage, bound to the beach in death alongside enigmatic spectral powers like the Spirit of Grol.

sections.title: The Severed Amulet
sections.body: Hidden deep within one of the rotting cargo holds rests a gruesome artifact: the severed head of the ogre Grol, still bearing his enchanted amulet. Why Gilnean sailors transported such a dark relic across the ocean remains a mystery, but the vengeful presence of Grol's restless spirit suggests the cargo may have contributed to their doom.

faq.answer: Shattershore is the eastern coastline of the Blasted Lands bordering the Great Sea, known for its shipwrecks and spectral inhabitants.

faq.q: Why are Gilnean ships wrecked here?
aliases: why are gilneas ships in blasted lands
faq.answer: Gilneas has long secluded itself behind the Greymane Wall, making the presence of their fleet so far south an anomaly. It is not fully known what mission drew them to the Blasted Lands or what brought down the vessels, though occult cargo and the hostile local magic are suspected.
The shore is haunted by drowned Gilnean sailors, merchants, and settlers, trapped in undeath alongside ancient spirits such as the ogre Spirit of Grol.

faq.q: What is hidden inside the shipwrecks?
faq.answer: Inside the hold of one ruined ship lies the preserved head of the ogre Grol, adorned with the Amulet of Grol, a talisman sought after by those studying the fell artifacts of the Blasted Lands.

angles.text: Finding vessels flying Gilnean heraldry broken on the shores of the Blasted Lands is a grim sight for Alliance explorers, given the northern nation's total silence behind the Greymane Wall.
